short_name: allowance is the Step Change 2030 fleet less the model's own 2030 roster
basis: Step Change CDP4 capacity (S001) and the templated 2030 roster (S003)
justification: The base chain follows the Step Change emissions intensity, so its 2030 fleet should be able to reach the Step Change 2030 fleet and not much further. Subtracting the capacity the model already holds from the capacity AEMO's own optimal development path reaches leaves exactly the new build the path implies, with no separate judgement about what the supply chain can deliver.
value: CDP4 2030 capacity per carrier minus the templated 2030 roster per carrier

short_name: one pooled NEM-wide cap per menu rather than a per-carrier schedule
justification: Splitting the allowance per carrier would pin the 2030 technology mix to AEMO's, which would turn the 2030 increment grid into a re-reading of AEMO's own answer rather than a measurement of what an extra terawatt hour or an extra tonne of abatement costs. Pooling bounds only the total, which is also the quantity a supply chain actually constrains, and leaves the mix to the optimiser. Generation and storage carry separate ceilings because they are separate supply chains.
value: one NEM-wide add_capacity_cap over every New Entrant generator and a second over every New Entrant battery

basis: Per-carrier allowances under A001 and A006
justification: Wind 5.9 GW, utility solar 12.4 GW and gas 0.6 GW give 18.9 GW of buildable generation, and the storage anchor gives a further 6.3 GW, for 18.9 GW rounded to 19 GW of generation, and the storage anchor gives 6.3 GW rounded to 6 GW of storage. Conventional hydro, coal, distillate and biomass are excluded because the model offers no new entrant in those carriers or already exceeds the path.
value: 19,000 MW of generation and 6,000 MW of storage for the 2030 period

short_name: no economic early retirement in the pinned period
justification: Skipping make_existing_reducible for the pinned period makes plant close on its announced year and not before, which is what the near term is actually contracted to do. The cost is that the model holds about 2.3 GW more coal at 2030 than the Step Change path, which the path retires on economics; the 2030 carbon cap then displaces that plant's output rather than its capacity.
used_for: Retirement behaviour inside the pinned period
value: disabled for every solve year at or before the pipeline period

short_name: undated committed batteries default to the period before the first milestone
basis: Templated storage roster (S003) and the workbook dates (S002)
justification: Twenty-nine committed batteries totalling 6,739 MW reach the templated roster with an empty commissioning date and are therefore treated as available from the start of the run, an effective build year of 2029 on a chain whose first milestone is 2030. Every one of those projects carries a workbook commissioning date of 2028 or earlier, so on this campaign's milestones the default is harmless; it would misdate the fleet on any chain starting in 2025 or 2026.
key: Effective build year of the undated committed batteries

short_name: storage allowance anchored on reported draft ISP storage
basis: Draft 2026 ISP storage milestone as reported (S004)
justification: Neither CDP4 file carries a storage column, so the storage allowance cannot be derived the way the generation allowance is. The only available anchor is a secondary report of AEMO's combined battery and pumped hydro milestone of 27 GW by 2030, against a templated 2030 storage roster of 20.7 GW. A separate workbook inconsistency omits ten committed batteries totalling 2.1 GW from that roster, so the 6.3 GW allowance is probably about 2 GW too generous.
used_for: Storage share of the pooled allowance

short_name: base cap schedule is the Step Change intensity and the 0.12 anchor is retired
justification: The campaign's earlier cap ladder held every schedule at an authored 0.12 t CO2e/MWh in 2030, for which no basis was ever recorded, and which forced the base chain to out-decarbonise AEMO's own path in its first period. The base chain now takes the Step Change scenario's own intensity at each milestone. The series is emissions over generation, so it is already on the source basis and the campaign's 0.91 delivery fraction does not apply to it.
used_for: Cap schedule of the base chain
